summary_en: This study tests ivosidenib, a tablet taken by mouth, in adults with IDH1-mutated cancers who also have liver or kidney impairment. Participants take 500 mg once a day in 28-day cycles, continuing until the end of the study. The study looks at safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug (pharmacokinetics), and drug effects (pharmacodynamics); it is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa ivosidenib, una tableta que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con cánceres con mutación IDH1 que también tienen insuficiencia hepática o renal. Los participantes toman 500 mg una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, y continúan hasta el final del estudio. El estudio analiza la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento (farmacocinética) y los efectos del medicamento (farmacodinamia); es un estudio de Fase 1.
who_for: Hematologic malignancy or solid tumor (not glioma) with a locally confirmed IDH1 R132 mutation
Moderate or severe liver impairment with adequate kidney function, or severe kidney impairment with adequate liver function
Control groups with adequate liver or kidney function
Women of childbearing potential who agree to use two effective birth control methods during the study and for 90 days after the last dose
not_for: Hematopoietic stem cell transplant within 60 days, or active graft-versus-host disease needing systemic therapy
Systemic anticancer, investigational, or radiation therapy within 14 days, or surgery within 4 weeks, before first dose
Calcineurin inhibitors within 4 weeks before enrollment
Significant heart disease within 6 months, including heart failure NYHA class III or IV, heart attack, unstable angina, or stroke
Known active inflammatory gastrointestinal disease, chronic diarrhea, or other conditions that limit oral drug absorption
